label: July 27 – August 2, 2026
intro: Double public holiday mid-week (Asalha Bucha Wed + Khao Phansa Thu) — use the holiday window for the NSM Brain Inside Out exhibition, then close the week with the Pattaya Fireworks Festival on the August 1–2 weekend.

activities.title: Pattaya International Fireworks Festival
activities.date: Friday July 31 – Sunday August 2 (best Sat–Sun Aug 1–2)
activities.time: Evening fireworks shows; beach open from afternoon
activities.location: Pattaya Beach, Pattaya (≈2 hrs from Bangkok by bus or car)
activities.price: Free beachfront viewing; food vendors on site
activities.why: International fireworks teams competing with massive synchronized shows over the sea. Beach + food stalls + epic explosions = perfect 5-year-old adventure. Add an overnight beach hotel stay for full magic.
activities.tip: Take the bus from Ekkamai Bus Terminal (~120 THB one way). Arrive by 5pm for a good beach spot. Bring earplugs — the shows are loud.

activities.title: NSM Brain Inside Out — Public Holiday Day Trip
activities.date: Wednesday July 29 or Thursday July 30 (public holidays)
activities.location: National Science Museum, Technopolis Khlong 5, Khlong Luang, Pathum Thani (~45 min north of Bangkok)
activities.price: Check nsm.or.th for current admission; children discounted
activities.why: Special exhibition 'Brain Inside Out' runs through August 13 — interactive journey through how brains work from infancy onwards. Plus 6 floors of hands-on science, the Natural History Museum's dinosaurs, and the IT Museum. A full-day building & making paradise for Thor.
activities.tip: The holiday weekday is quieter than weekends. Grab a Grab car from the BTS terminus or drive. Allocate a full day.

activities.title: Bangkok Planetarium & Science Museum — Holiday Morning
activities.location: Science Center for Education, Sukhumvit Road (near Ekkamai BTS)
activities.price: Planetarium show ~50–100 THB; science exhibits included
activities.why: Closer than NSM — 4 buildings including a planetarium dome, natural science exhibits, and hands-on science displays. Good holiday-morning option if staying in the city. Combine with Sub-Zero ice skating (same Ekkamai neighborhood) for a spectacular holiday double.
activities.tip: English planetarium show on Tuesdays only; Thai shows other days.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — Weekend Session
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24 (Phrom Phong BTS)
activities.price: 150 THB/hr weekends; skates + protective gear included
activities.why: Good backup plan if not heading to Pattaya. Regular rollerblading practice is how Thor's technique keeps improving. Dedicated beginner grass area and coaches on site.
activities.tip: Sunday 10–11am is the quietest window. Bring your own socks.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.date: Any day — book ahead on Klook
activities.location: Mega Bangna, Bang Phli, Samut Prakan (BTS On Nut + Grab, ~30 min)
activities.price: Discounted tickets on Klook (up to 45% off door price)
activities.why: Iron Man's Stark Mobile Lab, 4D stereoscopic dome, VR flight training, and character meet-and-greets with Iron Man, Thor the Avenger, Spider-Man, and Hulk. The definitive Iron Man experience in Bangkok.
activities.tip: Book on Klook. Weekday mornings have the shortest queues. Allow 2 hours minimum.

activities.title: Sub-Zero Ice Skating
activities.date: Any day (check website for holiday hours)
activities.time: Weekdays from 12:00 PM; weekends from 11:00 AM; closes 9:00 PM
activities.location: Sub-Zero Ice Skate Club, Major Cineplex Sukhumvit (Ekkamai BTS, skywalk access)
activities.price: 100 THB kids / 200 THB adults; skate rental included
activities.why: Two rinks: Arena Rink for fun skating, Academy Rink for coaching. Weekday daytime sessions (100 THB kids) are near-empty — best for building Thor's ice confidence at his own pace.
activities.tip: A 60-min coached lesson (~900 THB) shows visible progress in a single visit. Call ahead for holiday hours.

activities.title: Kad Kokoa Kids Bonbon Chocolate Workshop
activities.date: Monthly sessions — check kadkokoa.co or LINE Official for August dates
activities.price: Check kadkokoa.co for current session price
activities.why: Small-group bonbon-making workshop using real Thai craft chocolate. Thor makes his own chocolates and takes them home — pure building & making satisfaction. Book August before slots go.
activities.tip: Subscribe to their LINE Official account for new date notifications — sessions fill fast.
